title: Celebrating 4 Years at Amazon Web Services (AWS)
content:
Today I'm celebrating my 4th year at Amazon Web Services (AWS). It's been a journey of learning, growth, and gratitude — one that has shaped not only my career, but also how I see leadership, purpose, and people.

💛 Find Fulfillment in What You Do

Passion isn't just motivation — it's what turns everyday work into meaningful impact. When your "why" is strong, excellence follows naturally.

👥 Customers Come First — Always

True success happens when you create outcomes that genuinely improve someone else's world. Every decision, big or small, starts with that thought.

🌱 Continuous Growth Is the Only Constant

Every challenge, setback, and late-night brainstorm taught me something new. Growth doesn't always feel comfortable — and that's the point.

⚖️ Work–Life Harmony Is Real (and Needed)

It's not about balance, it's about rhythm. The moments spent with loved ones recharge the energy that fuels everything else.

💭 Stay Passionately Curious

Innovation starts with curiosity. The best ideas are often hidden behind the questions others don't think to ask.

❤️ People Make the Culture

Culture isn't the words on the wall — it's how we show up for each other, every single day.

Here's to growth, to people, and to purpose.

#HeresTo4YearsAtAWS #AWS #GrowthMindset #Leadership #CustomerObsession

title: Here's to 1,234 Days at Amazon Web Services (AWS)
content:
Here's to 1,234 days at Amazon Web Services (AWS), and here are my key takeaways so far:

📝 Writing is a superpower

The art of precise, concise communication through writing is fundamental at Amazon. A well-crafted document speaks volumes more than slides ever could.

🎯 Customer Obsession is Real

"Work backwards from the customer" isn't just a slogan - it's the foundation of every significant decision and innovation.

📊 Data is King—But Only if It's Actionable

Quality metrics lead to meaningful improvements, and even small insights can create massive impact.

🚪 Embrace Two-Way Door Decisions

Don't be afraid to try new things. Most decisions are reversible - if it doesn't work out, you can always step back and try another approach.

💭 Ask "Why?" Relentlessly

The simplest question is often the most powerful. It prevents wasted effort, ensures alignment, and keeps the focus on what truly matters.

⚖️ Prioritization is Key

Not all deadlines are created equal. Learning to prioritize effectively and set realistic expectations is crucial for long-term success.

🌱 Adopt a Growth Mindset

Continuous learning isn't optional - it's essential. The moment you stop learning is the moment you start falling behind.

💖 Follow Your Passion

Enjoying your work is not just a luxury, it's a necessity for long-term success and fulfillment. When you're passionate about what you do, great things happen naturally.

⚡ Work-Life Harmony is Non-Negotiable

Success at work means nothing without quality time with family and friends. Taking time to recharge and appreciate life outside of work isn't just important - it's essential for sustainable growth and happiness.

The most valuable lesson?

Culture isn't just what's written on the walls - it's how decisions are made every single day.

#HeresTo1234DaysAtAWS
